findings.location: Paragraph beginning “We sat with sagging hearts”
findings.source_quote: We sat with sagging hearts, listening, praying, thinking.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “mioyo yetu ikiwa imelegea” with “tukiwa na mioyo mizito” to convey the sorrow and discouragement more idiomatically.
findings.translation_quote: Tuliketi mioyo yetu ikiwa imelegea, tukisikiliza, tukiomba, tukifikiria.
